mapplus.desk.tool.pen.description: Draw freely, a pixel wide. Right-click erases, Shift-click carries on in a straight line, scroll to water the ink down
mapplus.desk.tool.brush.description: Draw freely, three pixels wide. Right-click erases, scroll to water the ink down
mapplus.desk.tool.line.description: Draw a line: drag from one end to the other. Shift keeps it straight, right-click erases
mapplus.desk.tool.box.description: Draw a box: drag from one corner to the other. Shift makes it square, right-click erases
mapplus.desk.tool.fill.description: Fill an area up to the ink around it. Scroll to water the ink down, to tint a zone. Right-click erases a patch of ink
mapplus.desk.tool.border.description: Draw a dashed border: drag from one end to the other. Shift keeps it straight
mapplus.desk.tool.label: Sign
mapplus.desk.tool.label.description: Write a label: click the map and type. Scroll or ↑ ↓ to size it, Enter to place it
mapplus.desk.tool.pin.description: Pin the banner to the map, with its patterns and its name if it has one
mapplus.desk.tool.icon.description: Stamp the sherd's picture on the map, in the ink of the dye, with the sherd's name if it has one
mapplus.desk.rack.loom: Needs a loom next to the table
mapplus.desk.hint.map: Place a map, or an empty map or paper to draw on
mapplus.desk.hint.tool: Pick up a tool to draw with: a feather or brush, string, an item frame or a bucket
mapplus.desk.hint.tool_loom: Pick up a tool to draw with: a feather or brush, string, an item frame or a bucket. To mark the map up: a sign, a banner, a pottery sherd or an iron chain
mapplus.desk.hint.loom: Place a loom next to the table to mark maps up with labels, pins, icons and borders
mapplus.desk.hint.material: Place a dye or ink sac to draw, a glow ink sac to make ink glow, or a water bottle to erase. Scroll over the map to water the ink down
mapplus.desk.hint.label_ink: Place a dye or ink sac to write in that color
mapplus.desk.hint.label_edit: Click to rewrite this label (with a glow ink sac in the second slot: make it glow), drag it to move it, scroll to size it, or drag it off the map to remove it
mapplus.desk.hint.pin_edit: Drag this pin to move it, scroll to size it, or drag it off the map to remove it
mapplus.desk.hint.pin_canvas: Draw on the empty map first; pins go on a map
mapplus.desk.hint.sealed: Sealed with wax. Scrape it off with an axe to draw again.
mapplus.desk.hint.sealed_by_other: Sealed with wax by another player. Only they, the map's maker or an operator can scrape it off.
mapplus.desk.hint.icon_edit: Drag this icon to move it, scroll to size it, or drag it off the map to remove it. Click it with a glow ink sac in the second slot to make it glow
mapplus.desk.hint.icon_ink: Place a dye or ink sac to stamp in that color
mapplus.desk.label.keys: Scroll or ↑ ↓ to size it, Enter to place it, Esc to cancel
mapplus.bounds.broken: The march broke off; the bounds of %s start again here
mapplus.bounds.closed: The bounds of %s are walked: plant the banner to claim them
mapplus.bounds.full: The banner can't remember any more: head back to close the bounds of %s
mapplus.bounds.progress: Bounds of %s: %s blocks walked, %s back to the start
mapplus.desk.sheet.out: Lay out the maps around it
mapplus.desk.sheet.in: Back to the map on the table
mapplus.desk.sheet.about: The maps you carry that border this one lie around it, to draw across
mapplus.desk.sheet.none: Put a map of somewhere on the table
mapplus.desk.sheet.keys: Ctrl and the mouse wheel over the map zoom too
mapplus.desk.hint.sheet: Click a map to put it on the table · Pick up a pen, string, frame or chain to draw across them
mapplus.desk.hint.sheet_empty: Carry the maps of the land around this one, and they lie around it here
mapplus.desk.hint.sheet_zoom: Zoom in to use this on one map
